title: Spiders Out-Eat All of Us
hook: Spiders in your walls eat more meat every year than you do.
script: Spiders in your walls eat more meat every year than you do. Could the small creatures in the corners of your home really out-eat all of humanity? Yes. Add up every spider on Earth and the meat they catch each year outweighs all the meat and fish eaten by all people combined. These tiny predators inject digestive enzymes into their prey and then suck out the resulting liquid meal. That’s why a Goliath Birdeater tarantula can devour a hummingbird whole. Their combined weight is around 25 million tons—more than 478,000 blue whales. And you are almost never more than a few feet from one.
